## Checklist

- [ ] Paper is under the correct **year** (newest first) and **venue**
- [ ] Venue stays in chronological order within the year (earlier conference first; Journal papers last)
- [ ] Entry has a unique paper anchor and uses the two-line README format: title ending in `<br>`, then scope, primary task, source badges, and resource links (only links that exist)
- [ ] `Core` / `Related` scope and primary task were verified from the paper or official author resources; a general method evaluated on human data stays Related
- [ ] Task index membership and category counts were updated; each paper appears once in the index
- [ ] Journal entries keep `— Journal Abbr Year` after the title
- [ ] Every paper has the data-source badge(s) from the README legend, based on its experiments; use `Unverified` if the source cannot be confirmed
- [ ] Experimental data-source tags are not presented as inference-input requirements
- [ ] Every link was opened and verified
- [ ] Header paper/scope totals and Overview yearly counts were updated; venue navigation was updated if a year or venue was added
